name: Diorama Utopia
original_name: ジオラマ・ユートピア
source:
The protagonist Lyrine, a young girl originally meant to be a sacrificial offering, is abruptly transported to the near-future city of Area Beltheul. She'd apparently been "kidnapped" by a self-proclaimed adventurer named Thor, and she ends up staying with his friends, Rada and Neiza.

In this unfamiliar city, Lyrine navigates her new life with uncertainty. Meanwhile, Beltheul's Public Safety Bureau begins searching for her, determined to take her into protective custody...

[Translated from [url=https://kumakumaf.notion.site/47f756fe5f2d4be78d4b6ea2550cb19e]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角莉琳（Lyrine）是一个原本要成为祭品的年轻女孩，却突然被传送到了近未来的城市贝尔图尔（Area Beltheul）。她显然被一个自称冒险家的托尔“绑架”了，她最终和他的朋友拉达和内扎住在一起。

在这个陌生的城市，莱琳充满不确定性地度过了她的新生活。与此同时，贝尔图尔的公共安全局开始寻找她，并决定将她保护性拘留……

[翻译自[url=https://kumakumaf.notion.site/47f756fe5f2d4be78d4b6ea2550cb19e]官网[/url]]
